verses.text: <pb/><e>Michtam nke Devid.</e> <pb/><t>Debem, Chineke: n'ihi na ab͕abàwom nime Gi.</t>
<t>Asiwom Jehova, Onye-nwem ka I bu:</t> <t>Ọdi-nmam adighi-eru Gi aru.</t>
<t>Asiwokwam ndi nsọ ndi nọ n'uwa,</t> <t>Na ndi di ebube nke ọ bu nání ihe-ha nātọm utọ:</t>
<t>Ihe-nb͕u-ha gāba uba, bú ndi were chi ọzọ n'ọnọdu Jehova:</t> <t>M'gaghi-awusi àjà-ihe-ọṅuṅu-ha nke ọbara,</t> <t>M'gaghi-eburu kwa aha-ha n'elu eb͕ub͕ere-ọnum.</t>
<t>Jehova bu òkè nke ihe m'ketara na ìkom:</t> <t>Gi onwe-gi nējide ihe rurum n'ife-nzà.</t>
<t>Udọ̀-ọtùtù nile adaworom n'ebe di utọ;</t> <t>N'ezie ihe-nketam dim ezi nma.</t>
<t>M'gāgọzi Jehova, Onye duworom ọdu:</t> <t>Ọzọ, akurum abua nādọm aka na nti n'abali nile.</t>
<t>Edowom Jehova n'irum mb͕e nile:</t> <t>N'hi na Ọ nọ n'aka-nrim, agaghi-ewzugam n'ọnọdum.</t>
<t>N'ihi nka obim aṅuriwo ọṅu, nsọpurum eteghariwo kwa egwú ọṅù:</t> <t>Ọzọ anu-arum gēbi na ntukwasi-obi.</t>
<t>N'ihi na I gaghi-arapuru ala-mọ nkpuru-obim;</t> <t>I gaghi-enye onye-ebere-Gi ka ọ hu nbibi.</t>
<t>I gēme ka m'mara uzọ ndu:</t> <t>Ojuju-afọ ọṅù di n'iru Gi;</t> <t>E! utọ di iche iche di n'aka-nri-Gi ebighi-ebi.</t>
